references.text: You shall fear the Lord your God; him you shall serve, and to him you shall hold fast, and by his name you shall swear.
For if you are careful to keep all these commandments that I give you, so that you love the Lord your God, walk in all his ways, and hold fast to him,
The Lord your God you shall follow; him you shall fear; his commandments you shall keep; his voice you shall obey; him you shall serve, and to him you shall hold fast.
So that you love the Lord your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For this is your life and the length of your days.

But be careful to live according to the commandment and the law that Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave you: that you shall love the Lord your God, walk in all his ways, keep his commandments, hold fast to him, and serve him with all your heart and all your soul.
Ruth chose to hold fast to her mother-in-law Naomi, an example of faithful devotion.
My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.
Barnabas encouraged everyone to hold fast to the Lord with a sincere heart.
